observations: Photo 0 shows a white/grey Sharp copier with the label 'SHARP' and 'AR-M207' on the front lower area.
Photo 1 shows the same Sharp AR-M207 body with A4/A3 markings visible on the lower right area.
Photo 2 shows the Sharp AR-M207 again with the front panel and 'AR-M207' marking visible; unit appears wrapped in plastic.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of location/usage history; only the machine appearance is shown.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; no control panel/spec sheet/photo of functions shown.
No photo of the counter/usage meter.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo of drum/toner installation or any jam-free test; photos only show the exterior wrapped unit.

risks.risk: Page count may be higher than claimed; counter not shown.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the machine’s total counter/usage screen (and any maintenance counters) with the model visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear used machine (worst case vs the claim).

risks.risk: “New drum and toner” may not be true, or may be low-quality/incorrect parts.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the drum/toner part numbers/labels (or the installed consumable packaging) and a close-up of the drum area access after opening the cover.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed fresh consumables (worst case: treat as used with consumables needing replacement).

risks.risk: No paper jam claim not testable from photos; could jam, feed poorly, or have misfeeds.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing a full print/copy run (e.g., 10–20 pages) from the tray with no jam message and normal output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may require servicing (worst case: treat as not proven jam-free).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (power cable, paper tray condition, output tray, manuals) can affect usability.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of included items: power cable, all trays, output tray, and any accessories shown laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as buyer may need to source missing accessories.

risks.risk: Condition/defects not visible due to plastic wrapping and limited angles (scratches, dents, internal issues).
risks.proof: Ask for photos with plastic removed, including: control panel close-up, paper path area, and any error indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average-wear used condition (worst case within what’s visible).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the copier’s counter/usage meter showing total pages (and any maintenance counters).
Photo of the installed drum/toner with part numbers/labels (or packaging) and a close-up inside the drum/toner compartment.
Short video of a test run: load paper, copy/print 10–20 pages, show no jam/error messages and normal output.
Photos of what’s included: power cable, all trays (A4/A3), output tray, and any accessories.
response.reason: The model (Sharp AR-M207) is readable from the photos, but the key pricing drivers in the seller’s claims (page count, new drum/toner, and jam-free operation) are not verifiable remotely because the counter and test evidence are missing.
